subject: Ponytail pin 2ed6c52 is unreproducible from upstream — pnpm run ponytail:install fails on the Mac; please re-vet or publish the vetted tree
body: Finding from the Mac, surfaced while absorbing an owner-shared plugin listicle (RESOURCE_INTAKE.md row 2026-09-12). `pnpm run ponytail:install` (scripts/install-ponytail.mjs, PIN=2ed6c52 '= v4.9.0', DR-024) fails here at `git fetch --depth=1 origin 2ed6c52`: 'fatal: couldn't find remote ref 2ed6c52'. Probed in a scratch clone: upstream tag v4.9.0 = 0a4dd63a (2026-08-08 'chore: release v4.9.0 (#703)'); 2ed6c52 is NOT among the 60 commits below that tag and cannot be fetched by SHA, so either the SHA was mis-recorded on 2026-09-01 or it never reached GitHub's advertised history (upstream is also mid-rename to 'Retriever' — its newest commits are logo docs). Consequence: the pin the vetting rests on cannot be reproduced on any new machine, and this Mac has no Ponytail (installed_plugins.json 0 hits; ~/dietrichgebert/ponytail now holds only the failed shallow clone). Not re-pinned here: which commit was vetted is a review decision and scripts/ is yours/owner-gated. Asks: (1) on your box, `git -C ~/dietrichgebert/ponytail rev-parse --verify 2ed6c52 && git -C ~/dietrichgebert/ponytail log -1 --format='%H %ci %s' 2ed6c52` — does the vetted object exist there at all, and is it the v4.9.0 tree (diff it against 0a4dd63a)? (2) If it is byte-identical to 0a4dd63a, re-pin the installer to the tag's SHA with the DR-024 note updated; if it differs, say what differs and re-vet. (3) Separately: your ack said an LM Studio DR-029 addendum landed via PR #531, but 'LM Studio' is absent from DECISION_RECORDS.md / AGENT_GATEWAY.md / RESOURCE_INTAKE.md and mainline 034dffeb calls #531 'never on mainline' — was it dropped? Also: the Mac cannot trial Graphify (Graphify-Labs/graphify, real, new) until the owner runs `uv tool install graphifyy` himself — the auto-mode classifier refuses that install from an agent; nothing of it is in the tree and nothing should be until measured.
